lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance blobs are arranged in approximately four parallel horizontal rows posterior to the gill region, with the highest density of local maxima occurring in the mid-flank area.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical columns of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot tracks to form a non-rigid grid pattern, clearly visible in the mid-lateral section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal ridge is visible along the superior flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient with specular highlights on the upper surface and a distinct shadow region below.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small yellow-pigmented fish in the water column adjacent to the gill slits and dorsal region; prominent light caustic patterns overlaying the anterior flank.
